How MediHub Works

The most transparent, efficient, and secure way to source medical supplies and equipment. We bridge the gap between healthcare facilities and top-tier suppliers.

For Healthcare Facilities

Streamline your procurement process from request to delivery.

1. Post a Tender

Create a detailed request for medical supplies, pharmaceuticals, or equipment. Set your budget, requirements, and deadline.

2. Receive & Compare Bids

Verified suppliers are notified instantly. Review incoming quotes side-by-side using our intelligent dashboard.

3. Award & Procure

Select the best offer. All communications and documentation are securely logged for compliance and auditing.

For Suppliers & Manufacturers

Access a continuous pipeline of high-quality sales opportunities.

1. Get Verified

Pass our standard compliance and quality checks to earn the "Verified Supplier" badge and build immediate trust.

2. Find Opportunities

Browse active tenders or let our matching algorithm notify you when requests align with your catalog and specialties.

3. Submit Quotes & Win

Submit competitive bids directly through the platform. Track your win rates and manage contracts in one place.

Why Choose MediHub?

100% Secure & Compliant

Built from the ground up to meet stringent healthcare data security and procurement standards.

Vetted Ecosystem

Every participant is verified. We eliminate the noise so you only deal with legitimate businesses.

Data-Driven Savings

Leverage historical data and competitive bidding to significantly lower your supply chain overhead.
